text:
Ellen R: Quick sync for TritonBank POC — they want to replace CompetitorZ. Main asks: response shape parity, token cost delta, webhook signature mapping, and security questionnaire. Can SEs help? cc @Noah T @Sanya P
Noah T: Do they use streaming or just completions? Also need their top 150 request samples.
Ellen R: Mostly completions + some streaming for logs. We'll ask for samples.
Sanya P: On pricing, procurement asked if we can cap spend for the trial. We can offer a two-week capped flat fee estimate. BillingBot: Note: flat-fee POC requires approval from revenue ops.
OpsSec: Security checklist: EU data residency, SAML for admin, audit export, webhook HMAC header mapping, and KMS requirement. Hosted supports signature verification; Dedicated required for customer-managed KMS.
Noah T: Proposed run plan: 1) Handshake (creds + cURLs) day 0-1, 2) Parity run (500 prompts) day 2-4, 3) Billing replay day 5, 4) Scale day 6-7.
Noah T: Example cURL to share:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth -d '{"client_id":"TRI-POC","client_secret":"..."}'
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"Acct balance"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions
```
Sanya P: Acceptance criteria: semantic parity >= 90% spot-check, token delta <= 20%, p95 latency <300ms.
OpsSec: Meridian? I mean Triton — will they accept IP+signature or insist on mTLS? If mTLS needed, recommend Dedicated.
Ellen R: I'll get their questionnaire and prompts and schedule kickoff Mon. Owners: Noah (tech), Sanya (commercial), OpsSec (security).
